items.note: Each sample has one band (periwinkle, yellow or teal) with ink title and pill tabs, then a raised outlined form card. The empty name field gets the pink halo and an error line with an icon, and the email field gets a red border plus an example address. Samples 1 and 3 put a 'Fix the highlighted fields' summary above the form. Sample 2 relies on inline errors only, which still say what to fix. Save changes is the only pink action, with an outlined Reset beside it.

Same layout on a near-black ground with dark raised cards, and the bands keep their saturated fill with ink text. The pink halo on the empty name field and the red email border with icon-led messages read clearly. The paper-filled current pill and the single pink Save keep the dark mapping.

At phone width the band collapses to the title, subtitle and a pill strip (sample 3 moves the strip below the band with an ink current pill), and the form is one column. Each error sits directly under its field with an icon and plain wording. Save and Reset stay in the flow at the bottom of the card, and nothing is clipped.

After saving, the pink Save button keeps its hard offset lift, and a small inline 'Saved' check sits next to Reset in the save row. No toast covers a control, and the fields show the saved values in plain outlined inputs.

In dark, the save row shows the pink Save with its light hard shadow, an ink-outlined Reset and the pink-dot 'Saved' confirmation on the dark raised card. Contrast holds and the band still owns the header.
The mobile save row keeps Save (lifted with its offset shadow), Reset and the inline 'Saved' check on one line inside the card. The confirmation is easy to see and overlaps nothing.

The plan-change dialog is a raised panel with an ink border, the hard offset shadow and an outlined close button. It holds a title, one sentence giving the price change and when it takes effect, an outlined Cancel and the single pink Confirm change. The dimming layer covers only one viewport height in the full-page capture, which comes from capturing a fixed scrim, not from the design.

In dark, the dialog keeps its dark raised panel, ink border and light hard shadow over a dimmed band and plan cards. Pink is used only on Confirm change and the small price tags, and the text is readable.

On mobile the dialog spans the column at the scroll position of the plan cards, with a hard shadow, a wrapped title and Cancel and Confirm side by side. The dim band covers the viewport around the dialog, which is the full-page capture of a fixed layer, and the dialog itself is fully visible.

In the change-password card, the confirm field gets the pink halo and an icon-led 'Passwords do not match' line, and a green 'Strength: Strong' check sits under the new password. Sample 3 adds a red-bordered summary at the top of the card. Update password is the one pink lift, and the sessions table below uses small outlined Revoke actions.

Dark keeps the same structure: the pink halo on the mismatched field, readable red and green helper text on the dark card, the pink Update password, and the session rows with outlined Revoke buttons inside a bordered table.

At phone width the password form is one column with the mismatch message under the confirm field and the pink submit in the flow. The sessions table reflows into stacked blocks with full-size Revoke buttons. Nothing is cut off.

Keyboard focus lands on a band tab pill (samples 1 and 2) or the sub-nav pill (sample 3) as a visible ink ring around the pill, next to the raised selected pill. The cards below list notification rows with ink switches and On/Off labels, so the state isn't shown by color alone. The ring sitting almost against the neighboring pill is the light-ring minor already recorded.
In dark, the focus ring is a pink outline around the focused pill. It stands out clearly against the band and the black sub-nav, and the paper-filled current pill stays distinct from it.

On mobile, the focused pill in the strip shows a thick ink ring (around the ink current pill in sample 3), with the switch cards stacked below and labels wrapping cleanly. Focus is obvious and nothing overlaps.
